'''Luke Robert Babbitt''' (born June 20, 1989) is an American former professional [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Nevada Wolf Pack men's basketball|Nevada Wolf Pack]] before declaring for the [[2010 NBA draft]] following his sophomore year.<ref name=bio>[https://web.archive.org/web/20110610231108/http://www.nevadawolfpack.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=10000&ATCLID=1482375 Luke Babbitt Bio]</ref> He was selected by the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]] with the 16th overall pick in the [[2010 NBA draft]], then traded to the [[Portland Trail Blazers]].

==Early life==
Babbitt was born in [[Cincinnati]], [[Ohio]]. At the age of nine his family moved to [[Reno, Nevada]]. Babbitt attended [[Galena High School (Nevada)|Galena High School]], where he was a 3-time All-State performer and a two-time [[Gatorade]] State Player of the Year in [[basketball]]. As a junior, Babbitt averaged 27.8 points and 9.5 rebounds per game while leading Galena to a state championship. Babbitt finished his high school career by scoring 2,941 points, which broke future college teammate [[Armon Johnson]]'s Nevada state scoring record of 2,616 points.

Considered a four-star recruit by [[Rivals.com]], Babbitt was listed as the No. 12 [[power forward (basketball)|power forward]] and the No. 31 player in the nation in 2008.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/footballrecruiting/basketball/recruiting/player-Luke-Babbitt-40772;_ylt=AsknZd4Fz3Xm_bTnftCk1xJGPZB4 |title=Luke Babbitt Recruiting Profile |access-date=2015-12-20 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151224013507/http://sports.yahoo.com/footballrecruiting/basketball/recruiting/player-Luke-Babbitt-40772 |archive-date=2015-12-24 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

==College career==
After originally verbally committing to [[Ohio State]], Babbitt backed out and decided to attend the [[University of Nevada]].<ref>[http://www.nevadaappeal.com/article/20070611/SPORTS/70611001 Report: Galena basketball star to play for Wolf Pack in '08]</ref> In his first game, Babbitt recorded a 20-point, 12-rebound [[Double (basketball)#Double-double|double-double]] versus [[Montana State University – Bozeman|Montana State]]. He went on to average 16.9 points per game during his [[freshman]] year including a season-high 30 points on March 12, 2009, versus [[San Jose State University|San Jose State]].<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20090319141626/http://sports.espn.go.com/ncb/recap?gameId=290712440 Nevada 78, San Jose St. 69 – ESPN.com]</ref>

In his sophomore season, Babbitt led the team in scoring with 21.9 points per game. He scored a career-high 33 points in the [[Western Athletic Conference]] tournament semifinals on March 13, 2010, versus [[New Mexico State University|New Mexico State]].<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20121104190812/http://sports.espn.go.com/ncb/recap?gameId=300712440 New Mexico St. 80, Nevada 79 – ESPN.com]</ref> Despite losing that game and ending their hopes of going to the [[NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Championship|NCAA Tournament]], Nevada was invited to the [[National Invitation Tournament|NIT]], where they lost in the second round to the [[University of Rhode Island]].<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20100327045424/http://sports.espn.go.com/ncb/recap?gameId=300810227 James leads way as Rams hold off Wolf Pack]</ref>

On April 20, 2010, Babbitt hired an agent and declared for the [[2010 NBA draft|NBA draft]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=April 20, 2010 |title=Babbitt hires agent, declares for draft |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/draft2010/news/story?id=5120077 |access-date=2026-06-29 |website=ESPN.com|agency=Associated Press}}</ref>

==Professional career==

===Portland Trail Blazers (2010–2013)===
Babbitt was selected with the 16th overall pick by the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]] in the [[2010 NBA draft]]. His rights were later traded, along with Wolves forward [[Ryan Gomes]], to the [[Portland Trail Blazers]] in exchange for [[Martell Webster]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/timberwolves/news/minnesota_acquires_martell_web_2010_06_25.html|title=Minnesota Acquires Martell Webster from Portland|date=June 25, 2010|work=NBA.com|publisher=Turner Sports Interactive, Inc.|access-date=June 25, 2010}}</ref> On July 9, 2010, Babbitt signed his rookie contract with the Blazers.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.iamatrailblazersfan.com/ArticleDisplayPlaceholder/tabid/192/ItemID/1563/Default.aspx |title=TRAIL BLAZERS SIGN LUKE BABBITT |access-date=2010-07-06 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120302045224/http://www.iamatrailblazersfan.com/ArticleDisplayPlaceholder/tabid/192/ItemID/1563/Default.aspx |archive-date=2012-03-02 |url-status=usurped }}</ref> He then joined the Blazers for the 2010 NBA Summer League.

[[File:Luke Babbitt Blazers.jpg|thumb|Babbitt in 2011 with the Portland Trail Blazers]]
On December 8, 2010, Babbitt was assigned to the [[Idaho Stampede]] of the [[NBA D-League]].<ref>[http://www.nba.com/dleague/idaho/babbitt_101208.html Trail Blazers Assign Luke Babbitt To Idaho Stampede] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140222035707/http://www.nba.com/dleague/idaho/babbitt_101208.html |date=2014-02-22 }}</ref> On December 18, 2010, he was recalled by the Trail Blazers.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.kolotv.com/sports/headlines/Blazers_Recall_Babbitt_From_D-League_112131554.html |title=Blazers Recall Babbitt From D-League |access-date=December 19, 2010 |archive-date=July 17, 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110717182315/http://www.kolotv.com/sports/headlines/Blazers_Recall_Babbitt_From_D-League_112131554.html |url-status=dead }}</ref> On March 3, 2011, he was reassigned to the Idaho Stampede.<ref>[http://www.oregonlive.com/blazers/index.ssf/2011/03/trail_blazers_luke_babbitt_hea.html Trail Blazers' Luke Babbitt heads to NBA Development League]</ref> On March 28, 2011, he was recalled by the Trail Blazers. On January 4, 2012, he was reassigned to the Idaho Stampede. On January 10, 2012, he was recalled again.<ref>[http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=9038 Blazers recall Luke Babbitt from D-League]</ref>

Babbitt joined the Trail Blazers for the 2012 NBA Summer League.

===Nizhny Novgorod (2013–2014)===
In August 2013, Babbitt signed with [[BC Nizhny Novgorod|Nizhny Novgorod]] of Russia for the 2013–14 season.<ref>{{cite news|title=Nizhny Novgorod announced Luke Babbitt|url=http://www.sportando.net/eng/europe/russia/62434/nizhny-novgorod-announced-luke-babbitt.html|date=August 30, 2013|work=Sportando.net|access-date=February 4, 2014}}</ref> In January 2014, he left Russia under controversial circumstances.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/russia/110941/luke-babbitt-breaks-contract-with-nizhny-russian-team-won-t-sign-his-letter-of-clearance.html |title=Luke Babbitt breaks contract with Nizhny. Russian team won't sign his letter of clearance |access-date=2014-05-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140518102155/http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/russia/110941/luke-babbitt-breaks-contract-with-nizhny-russian-team-won-t-sign-his-letter-of-clearance.html |archive-date=2014-05-18 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

===New Orleans Pelicans (2014–2016)===
On February 4, 2014, Babbitt signed with the [[New Orleans Pelicans]].<ref>{{cite news|title=PELICANS SIGN BABBITT|url=http://www.nba.com/pelicans/news/pelicans-sign-babbitt|access-date=February 4, 2014|work=NBA.com|date=July 20, 2015}}</ref> On July 20, 2015, he re-signed with the Pelicans.<ref>{{cite news|title=Pelicans Re-Sign Luke Babbitt|url=http://www.nba.com/pelicans/news/pelicans-re-sign-luke-babbitt|access-date=July 20, 2015|work=NBA.com|date=July 20, 2015}}</ref>

===Miami Heat (2016–2017)===
On July 10, 2016, Babbitt was traded to the [[Miami Heat]] in exchange for a 2018 second-round draft pick and cash considerations.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/heat/heat-acquire-luke-babbitt|title=HEAT Acquire Luke Babbitt|work=NBA.com|date=July 10, 2016|access-date=July 10, 2016}}</ref>

=== Atlanta Hawks (2017–2018) ===
Babbitt signed with the [[Atlanta Hawks]] on August 9, 2017.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/hawks/atlanta-hawks-sign-luke-babbitt|title=Atlanta Hawks Sign Luke Babbitt|work=NBA.com|date=August 9, 2017|access-date=August 9, 2017}}</ref>

=== Return to Miami (2018) ===
Babbitt was traded back to the Heat on February 8, 2018, in exchange for [[Okaro White]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/heat/news/heat-acquire-luke-babbitt|title=HEAT Acquire Luke Babbitt|work=NBA.com|date=February 8, 2018|access-date=February 8, 2018}}</ref>
